query:
SELECT pi.id, pi.imageUrl as url, pi.caption as alt, pc.slug as cat_slug, pc.name as cat_name, ps.title as shoot_title
FROM portfolio_images pi 
JOIN portfolio_shoots ps ON pi.shootId = ps.id
JOIN portfolio_categories pc ON ps.categoryId = pc.id 
WHERE pi.imageUrl IS NOT NULL AND ps.isActive = 1
ORDER BY pc.id, ps.id, pi.order 
LIMIT 50;
